canonical_note4.text:
The full original P16.5 is NOT solved. The unchanged task and family, completion criteria, exact assignment, complete grants, unreviewed supplied bodies, and all their positive-volume and additional zero-volume statements remain preserved.

One additional zero-volume theorem is independent of n3's conditional package. Let actual rational L be numerically trivial on any retained smooth integral projective n-fold, n≥1, including nontorsion Pic0 bundles. Use the varying-actual-bundle single-net convention and reference zero. For rational ε>0, actual L+εA is ample; its weight-zero generating system is zero everywhere. These constant scalars give one defining net for zero and its shifts. Conversely normalize u∈PSH(0) at v0 to zero. Integer tensoring gives mu∈PSH(0) for every positive integer m. Embed each in the same actual ample cone. G0 compactness gives −C_z≤mu(z)≤0 independently of m at each rational divisorial z, so u(z)=0. Along divisorial rays the endpoint of the affine-max stages is finite convex and continuous; rational equality extends to real equality. G0 determination gives u=0 everywhere. Thus PSH(0)=R.

Raw ample perturbations on constants have mass ε^nA^n→0 and energy cε^nA^n→0. Positivity bounds each continuous integral by its sup norm times that mass. Their unique raw limit is zero; raw energy is zero on the entire classified cone, E1(0)=R, and the operator is zero. The sole positive mass-zero target is literally zero; solutions form one class modulo constants. Comparison and zero derivatives are immediate. No zero mass is normalized to a probability.

This is precisely numerical zero, not every pseudoeffective zero-volume class. On P1×P1, nonzero nef L=p1*O(1) has volume zero and both zero and a nonconstant bounded generated-system scalar with sections z1,z0 and weights 0,−1. Along the branch toward z1=0 it equals max(−s,−1). Tensor both into L+εO(1,1). Their raw positive masses are 2ε(1+ε)→0, so both top limits vanish although their potentials differ by more than a constant. This obstructs naive uniqueness on that entire zero-mass cone; it does not disprove the positive-volume task.

The unresolved positive-volume assertions are: independently establish all of S1–S3 for the literal single-net cone and entire actual E1 space; establish M1–M2 and every moving/weak-output compatibility; identify the outer map with the genuine original operator for all admissible simultaneous unbounded weighted and mixed approximations; prove strict-winning locality and strict Borel comparison, including required nonalgebraic negligible-set nullness. The set {u<v} need not be open. Conditional attainment and separation do not discharge these antecedents. Any further nonzero zero-volume range requires its own actual reference and replacing datum. No other P16 axis is claimed solved.
